title: Additional Fluid Tools
description: The &6Siphon&r is a tool used to extract input fluids from a machine. Right-clicking a machine with content in it's input tanks will fill any fluid barrels, universal tanks or pipettes (if the fluid amount cannot fill any of the previous options).
&6Pipettes&r can be used to input specific amounts of fluids. Right-clicking or Shift-Right-clicking will increase or decrease the fluid amount.
